(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/update-project-metadata.md): Updates name, description, icon or visibility. Requir
es project admin; a non-member gets `404` rather than `403`, so the response never confirms that a project exists. The project's s
erver map is not updatable here — see the per-server routes.\n- [What the caller may do here](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/projects/what-the-caller-may-do-here.md): Role, gate state, plan limits and a set of derived booleans — so an agent on a static

ail. This is the provisioning entry point: every eval, host and environment route addresses servers that were created here. Names

r's revisions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/list-a-servers-revisions.md): A saved server's stored revisions, newe
st first. A revision is a capture of the server's tools and server info, recorded whenever they change on a connect, an eval run o

ery tool's definition and the server info the server reported. `droppedFields` lists paths storage dropped for size; their values

): Compares `from` (default: the revision before) with `revisionNumber`: tools added and removed with their definitions, tools cha
nged with the fields that moved and both definitions, and each changed server info field with both values. Revision 1 has nothing

-server.md): The server's detail, projected toward the hosted shape. Secrets are never included — `hasClientSecret` reports presen
ce only. A server id from another project reads as `404`.\n- [Delete a saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers
/delete-a-saved-server.md): Soft-deletes the server and schedules its cascade: MCP Apps views, hosted OAuth credentials, encrypted
secret objects, and a rotation of every host config that referenced it. The cascade is ASYNCHRONOUS, so a read immediately after

nce/servers/update-a-saved-server.md): Sparse update: omitted fields are unchanged. Renaming re-checks per-workspace uniqueness (`
409` on a clash). Editing a server shared as an OAuth connection requires project admin. `clientSecret` and `clearClientSecret` ar
e mutually exclusive.\n- [List a project's server groups](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/list-a-projects-serve
r-groups.md): A server group is an immutable snapshot of a set of saved servers. Pinning one on an environment is what keeps a run

s edited.\n- [Snapshot servers into a server group](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/snapshot-servers-into-a-ser
ver-group.md): Creates a server group holding exactly the given servers and responds `201` with its detail. Groups are create-only

e per project, so a clash responds `409`. Servers must…\n- [List a project's environments](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/e
nvironments/list-a-projects-environments.md): The project environments saved in the project. Archived environments are excluded un
less `includeArchived=true` — you need that to find one to restore.\n- [Create an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referen
ce/environments/create-an-environment.md): Create a project environment from a host plus, optionally, a standalone server group, a

ct admin.\n- [Check what this deployment's environment surface supports](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/check-
